Reset the board

If the board has been changed since our last service, follow the procedure below for the board you're using.

Digital board

Latest known-good: Sunday Morning

Scene 1 · saved 2026-05-04

  1. Power on the board if needed.
  2. Press the SCENES button on the board and load Scene 1: Sunday Morning.
  3. Compare the board's display against the photo below.
  4. If anything looks different, follow the per-channel notes.

All saved scenes →

Analog board

Latest known-good: Sunday Morning (analog board)

Saved 2026-05-04

  1. Compare every knob and fader against the photo + diagram below.
  2. Work left to right across the board.
  3. Follow the per-channel notes for any channel that looks different.
Per-channel notes
  1. Ch 1: Pastor mic — gain knob at 11 o'clock, HPF in, fader at 0
  2. Ch 2: Worship vocal — gain at 1 o'clock, fader at 0
  3. Ch 3-4: Backup vocals — gain at 1 o'clock, faders at -3
  4. Ch 5: Acoustic guitar DI — gain at 12, fader at -6
  5. Ch 6-7: Keys L/R — gain at 2, faders at -3
  6. All channels: EQ knobs at 12 o'clock (flat) unless noted
  7. AUX 1 monitor send: see photo
  8. Master fader: at the 'unity' line
